main.description: Get the leaderboard of an event. Total points are the sum of approved non-goal checkpoint points (each checkpoint counts once per team) and a finish-time bonus of 30, 20, 10, 5, 3, 2, or 1 points for the first through seventh finish positions. Goal finish time is the server indexedAt timestamp; tied finishers share points. Teams without a goal submission receive no finish-time bonus.
